stringUnit.value: Look at the doors and windows of the lanes and old apartments, and start reading Shanghai from its residents' everyday life.
看里弄与老公寓的门窗细节，把阅读上海的起点放在居民日常里。
2288 North Sichuan Road, Hongkou District, Shanghai
上海市虹口区四川北路2288号
Walk under the trees and by the lake, listen to the residents' choirs, then wander the literary streets nearby.
在树荫与湖边走一段，听听居民合唱，再接着逛周边的文学街巷。
2056 North Sichuan Road, Hongkou District, Shanghai
上海市虹口区四川北路2056号
Browse books on Shanghai-style culture and literature in a reading room that carries on an old bookshop.
在老书店延续出的阅读空间里，翻翻海派文化与文学主题的书。
北京市西城区砖塔胡同
Start at the old pagoda by the hutong entrance and follow the lanes to see how old Beijing courtyards meet the street.
从胡同口的古塔读起，沿公共街巷观察老北京院落与街道的关系。
North side of middle Baizhifang East Street, Xicheng District, Beijing
北京市西城区白纸坊东街中部路北
A small park built around everyday leisure. Slow down here and watch the trees and the neighborhood.
一座围绕日常休闲展开的小公园，适合把行程放慢，看看树木与邻里生活。
43 Xisi South Street, Xicheng District, Beijing
北京市西城区西四南大街43号
Leaf through local Beijing history in the Wansong Pagoda courtyard, then get to know the hutong in front of you.
在万松老人塔院内翻一册北京地方文献，从纸页里接着认识眼前的胡同。
Fenghuangshan Jiao Road and the public lanes around Mantoushan, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou
杭州市上城区凤凰山脚路、馒头山社区周边公共街巷
Follow the foot of the hill into lanes of white walls and black tiles, and see Hangzhou's everyday life beyond its lakes and hills.
沿山脚走进白墙黑瓦的生活街巷，看杭州山水之外的社区日常。
杭州市拱墅区白石路125号
Trade the photo stop for a slow lakeside walk and feel the daily rhythm of north Hangzhou between fields and lawns.
把打卡换成一段湖边慢走，在运动场与绿地之间感受城北的日常节奏。
杭州市西湖区玉皇山路73-1号
See another side of Hangzhou through textile patterns and clothing, and take time with the materials and craft.
从织物纹样与服饰看杭州的另一面，留一点时间观察材料与工艺。
成都市锦江区镋钯街公共道路
Stroll a western-Sichuan street at walking scale and see old buildings and today's small shops side by side.
沿川西街巷的尺度慢走，看看旧街建筑与今日小店如何并排生活。
成都市武侯区望江路30号至50号
Walk through the bamboo and along the river, and meet the city's memories of the poet Xue Tao.
沿竹林与江边走一段，认识与薛涛有关的城市记忆。
Luzhen Hilltop Plaza, 18 Lushan Avenue Section 2, Tianfu New Area, Chengdu
成都市天府新区麓山大道二段18号麓镇山顶广场
Give an afternoon to contemporary art and switch between the galleries and the neighborhood to see the city differently.
留一个下午给当代艺术，在展厅与社区之间切换观看城市的方式。
238 Fangzhi West Street, Baqiao District, Xi'an
西安市灞桥区纺织西街238号
Walk the lanes of an old textile mill and see its workshops, studios and industrial scale.
沿旧纺织厂的公共街巷看厂房、创作空间与工业留下的尺度。
Along the moat outside the West Gate, Huancheng West Road, Lianhu District, Xi'an
西安市莲湖区环城西路、西门外护城河沿线
Walk the green space outside the city wall and watch the moat, the shade and residents' morning and evening routines.
在城墙外的公共绿地走走，看护城河、树荫与居民的晨晚活动。
14 Chang'an North Road, Beilin District, Xi'an
西安市碑林区长安北路14号
Change the pace of your trip with an exhibition and get close to Shaanxi culture through painting and local crafts.
用一场美术展切换旅行节奏，从绘画与地方工艺接近陕西文化。
From Tongyuanju Station to Shuangfeng Hill and the Tongyuan Light city terrace, Nan'an District, Chongqing
重庆市南岸区铜元局站至双峰山、铜元之光城市阳台一带
Follow the trail linking a metro station to a hillside neighborhood and see how Chongqing really climbs and commutes.
沿连接轨道站与山坡社区的步道，观察重庆真实的高差与日常通行。
重庆市沙坪坝区石小路155号
Walk the hill paths slowly and, from the shade and lookouts, see the mountain city's neighborhoods from another height.
沿山间步道慢走，在绿荫与观景处看看山城社区的另一种高度。
7 Huangjueping Main Street, Jiulongpo District, Chongqing
重庆市九龙坡区黄桷坪正街7号
Sit a while among wooden tables, teacups and chatter, and let everyday life set the pace.
在木桌、茶盏与聊天声之间坐一会儿，把看城市的速度交还给日常。
Public lanes of OCT-LOFT, Nanshan District, Shenzhen
深圳市南山区华侨城创意文化园公共街巷
Walk the lanes between old factory buildings, where design studios, galleries and trees sit side by side.
沿旧厂房之间的街巷，看设计工作室、展览空间与树木相邻的日常。
深圳市福田区农园路30号
Take a walk among the lychee trees and paths and enjoy the green inside Shenzhen's neighborhoods.
在荔枝林与步道间留一段散步时间，看看深圳社区里的绿意。
深圳市南山区深南大道9013号
Give the works and archives some time, and read from the artist's life to the world beyond the city.
给作品与文献留一点观看时间，从艺术家的经历读到城市之外的世界。
Public streets around Xinhepu Road and Xuguyuan Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou
广州市越秀区新河浦路、恤孤院路周边公共道路
Follow red-brick villas and the creek, notice the details, and read the street scale of Guangzhou's early-modern neighborhoods.
沿红砖洋房与河涌观察建筑细节，读广州近代社区留下的街巷尺度。
广州市海珠区前进路146号
Walk past bamboo, the lake and old trees in the green space where locals take their daily rest.
沿竹林、湖面与老树走一段，看看老广日常休息的城市绿地。
广州市越秀区恤孤院路9号
See contemporary shows inside an old villa and take in the building and the works together.
在老洋房里看当代展览，把建筑细节与作品放在一起慢慢看。
Public streets around Qingdao Road and the Pinghe Packing Plant, Jiang'an District, Wuhan
武汉市江岸区青岛路、平和打包厂周边公共道路
Trace old Hankou's renewal along red-brick industrial buildings, and read its trading past in the streets.
沿红砖工业建筑观察老汉口的城市更新，从街道读到曾经的商贸生活。
武汉市江岸区解放大道1861号
Stroll by the lake and under the trees, and give the gap between galleries and shops to some city green.
在湖边与树荫间散步，把看展探店之间的空档留给一段城市绿地。
16 Yezhihu West Road, Hongshan District, Wuhan
武汉市洪山区野芷湖西路16号
See another Wuhan through contemporary art and young creators, and stay a few extra minutes with one work.
从当代艺术与青年创作中看另一面的武汉，给一件作品多停留几分钟。
Tai Nan Street, Sham Shui Po, Kowloon, Hong Kong
香港九龙深水埗大南街公共道路
Among leather, fabric and today's maker shops, see how Sham Shui Po's trades connect with neighborhood life.
从皮革、布料与今日创作小店之间，观察深水埗制造业与社区生活的连接。
Behind the Cattle Depot, at San Shan Road and the East Kowloon Corridor, To Kwa Wan, Kowloon, Hong Kong
香港九龙土瓜湾新山道与东九龙走廊交界、牛棚后方
Walk a public space that keeps its industrial traces, where red brick, green space and an art community meet.
在保留工业痕迹的公共休憩空间走走，看看红砖、绿地与艺术社区如何相邻。
14/F Foo Tak Building, 365–367 Hennessy Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong
香港湾仔轩尼诗道365–367号富德楼14楼
Browse art books and independent publishing, and get close to local creative life through a small book.
翻翻艺术书与独立出版，从一本小书接近本地创作的日常。
Public streets around Huaxin Road and Xingfu Road, Siming District, Xiamen
厦门市思明区华新路、幸福路周边公共道路
Stroll past old overseas-Chinese villas in the shade, on Xiamen lanes still woven into residents' lives.
沿华侨老别墅与树荫慢走，看一段仍与居民日常交织的厦门街巷。
Zhonglun Park along Jinshang Road and Lüling Road, Huli District, Xiamen
厦门市湖里区金尚路、吕岭路沿线忠仑公园
Follow wooded paths and gentle slopes, and bring the pace of travel back to an everyday walk.
沿林间步道与缓坡看看城市绿意，把远行的节奏放回一次日常散步。
Three Shadows Xiamen Photography Art Center
三影堂厦门摄影艺术中心
Room 301, Podium of Building 2, Xinglin Bay Business Center, Jimei District, Xiamen
厦门市集美区杏林湾商务营运中心二号楼裙楼301
Let a photography show change how you look, and see the city and its people through images.
用一场摄影展切换观看方式，在影像里看看城市与人的关系。
